859: function _M:addTemporaryValue(prop, v, noupdate)
860: 	if not self.compute_vals then self.compute_vals = {n=0} end
861: 
862: 	local t = self.compute_vals
863: 	local id = t.n + 1
864: 	while t[id] ~= nil do id = id + 1 end
865: 	t[id] = v
866: 	t.n = id

966: 	-- Update the base prop
967: 	if not noupdate then
968: 		recursive(initial_base, initial_prop, v, "add")
969: 	end
970: 
971: 	return id
972: end

174: 		self:removeTemporaryValue("global_speed_add", eff.tmpid)
175: 	end,
176: 	on_merge = function(self, old_eff, new_eff)
177: 		max = math.max(old_eff.max, new_eff.max)
178: 		old_eff.power = math.min(old_eff.power + new_eff.power, max)
179: 		self:removeTemporaryValue("global_speed_add", old_eff.tmpid)
180: 		old_eff.tmpid = self:addTemporaryValue("global_speed_add", -old_eff.power)
181: 		return old_eff
